about: Modwerk source-only phaser package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/phaser. A send effect: the site builds it on the Modwerk base's send-bus variant.

mods.title: PHASER
mods.summary: A stereo phaser for the Rytm's send bus: 2 to 8 all-pass stages swept by an LFO you can square and slow.
mods.description: A stereo phaser for the Rytm's send bus: 2 to 8 all-pass stages swept by an LFO you can square and slow.
mods.author: stigmagit
mods.on_unit: Test build MB02, with the same source built locally, ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as the author reported; this package has not run on a unit.
